text: “Sir Sagramore, ye will grant him leave to borrow.” “And I will lend!” said Sir Launcelot, limping up. “He is as brave a knight of his hands as any that be on live, and he shall have mine.” He put his hand on his sword to draw it, but Sir Sagramor said: “Stay, it may not be. He shall fight with his own weapons; it was his privilege to choose them and bring them. If he has erred, on his head be it.” “Knight!” said the king. “Thou'rt overwrought with passion; it disorders thy mind.

provenance.work: A Connecticut Yankee in King Arthur's Court
